factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated EBITDA for 06 months of 2026 decreased by 0.8% and was 7 508 thousand EUR, compared to 7 566 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025. [Management Report] / Selected Financial Indicators table confirms value and change

factual_claims.claim: Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company dropped significantly by 31.5% to 3,961 thousand EUR, yielding earnings per share of 0.11 EUR against 0.16 EUR previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company for 06 months of 2026 amounted 3 961 thousand EUR. [Management Report] / Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent: 3,961 vs 5,781, change -31.5% / EPS: 0.11 vs 0.16 [Selected Financial Indicators and Note 8]

factual_claims.claim: The decline was influenced by higher income tax expenses and a reduction in net finance income to 444 thousand EUR.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income tax expense: 1,870 vs 1,322 [Consolidated Income Statement] / Net finance income: 444 vs 1,652 [Consolidated Income Statement]. Management Report attributes net profit decline to these factors.

factual_claims.claim: Despite the lower bottom line, operating cash flow strengthened substantially, rising 96.6% to 6,842 thousand EUR.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating cash flow for the period: 6,842 vs 3,481, change +96.6% [Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows]

factual_claims.claim: The company maintained a robust financial position with total assets increasing by 5.1% to 98,603 thousand EUR.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Total assets: 98,603 vs 93,847, change +5.1% [Consolidated Statement of Financial Position]

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents grew by 87.4% to 12,443 thousand EUR, and equity attributable to parent shareholders rose by 6.1% to 81,479 thousand EUR.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash and cash equivalents: 12,443 vs 6,639, change +87.4% [Note 2] / Equity attributable to equity holders of the Parent: 81,479 vs 76,768, change +6.1% [Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity]

factual_claims.claim: Working capital shifts included a decrease in the inventory balance by 1,535 thousand EUR to 29,702 thousand EUR, contrasting with an increase in trade and other receivables by 846 thousand EUR.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Inventory: 29,702 vs 31,237, change -1,535 [Note 4] / Trade and other receivables: 2,175 vs 1,329, change +846 [Note 3]

factual_claims.claim: Capital investments totaled 115 thousand EUR, directed mainly toward opening and renovating own stores.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: During 06 months of 2026 the Group’s investments into property, plant and equipment totalled 115 thousand EUR [...] Investments were made mainly into opening and renovating own stores [...] [Investments section]

factual_claims.claim: The Group operated 135 owned stores as of June 30, with 67 in Russia and 65 in Belarus, while total employment stood at 1,594 employees.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: At the end of the reporting period the Group and its franchising partners operated 525 Milavitsa and 22 Lauma Lingerie brand stores, including 135 stores operated directly by the Group (as of 31 December 2025: 137 stores). [Own & franchise store locations] / As of 30 June 2026, the Group employed 1 594 people (as of 31 December 2025: 1 639 people). [Personnel section]

factual_claims.claim: Return on assets declined to 7.8% from 10.0%, and return on equity decreased to 9.5% from 12.5%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ROA: 7.8% vs 10.0% / ROE: 9.5% vs 12.5% [Selected Financial Indicators table]

factual_claims.claim: Shareholders approved the 2025 results, leaving retained earnings undistributed, and appointed Treetiger OÜ as auditor.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: On May 21, 2026 Silvano Fashion Group held its regular Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The Meeting adopted the following decisions: 2.3. Leave the net profit undistributed [...] 1.1. To appoint the auditing company Treetiger OÜ [...] [Decisions made by governing bodies]

factual_claims.claim: Management emphasized a strategy to improve retail profitability in Russia amidst currency challenges.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Group will focus on improving profitability of its retail business, we will also continue to expand our store chain there depending on the availability of reasonably priced sales areas. [Russia Economic Outlook]
